shared:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original production-style 2D tower-defense GAME ASSET SHEET, transparent background. Six separate polished sprites on an EXACT regular THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW rectangular atlas. Aspect ratio3:2. Every slot is a square of exactly equal size. Each sprite centered horizontally AND vertically in its slot, all silhouette and its tiny shadow confined within middle72% of the slot. Generous transparent gutters. NO labels, NO lines, NO grid, NO frames, NO ground tiles, NO background scenery, NO text. Real alpha transparency, not checkerboard. This is not a UI, not an icon pack, not a screenshot.
Order: top left a distinctive ranged crossbow/archer tower; top middle a chunky cannon/artillery tower; top right a magical damage tower; bottom left an ice/slow support tower; bottom middle small fast enemy creature; bottom right heavy armored enemy creature. Four tower foundations same compact ONE TILE footprint; footing clearly visible, no loose scenery. Enemy bodies about80% tower height. All six face slightly toward bottom right, consistent elevated game sprite view, not dramatic perspective. These assets must be attractive at game scale: memorable silhouettes, crafted material transitions, 3-step controlled shading, sharp edges, tasteful highlights, a few functional details. Medium-high polish from a real small game art team. MORE character than flat clipart or chess icons, LESS detail than cinematic fantasy concept art. NO glowing halos, no vast particles, no photorealism, no generic low-poly cones, no simplistic flat vector symbol, no pastel baby-toy look. Every weapon stays within its own square. All designs original, no franchise characters. Specific art direction:

variants.name: 숲길 원정대
variants.prompt: Hand-painted crisp 2D fantasy tactics sprites, pine green cloth, aged ivory stone, warm cedar wood, cobalt metal, strong readable warm/cool contrast. Crossbow with a small hooded ranger operator and blue pennant; brass-rimmed iron cannon; amber brazier with miniature red-robed fire wizard; faceted ice shrine; mischievous red leaf goblin with little boots; squat plated forest boar with curved tusks. Whimsical adventure but not childish, expressive original creatures.

variants.name: 도깨비 산성
variants.prompt: Original Korean-fantasy cartoon game sprites with restrained cel paint, warm terracotta, deep jade roof accents, charcoal timber and brass. Compact repeating crossbow on a Korean wooden watchpost; squat bronze hwacha-like launcher; tiny red-robed talisman sorcerer on stone foot; blue jade bell shrine with frost ornament; small mischievous red dokkaebi with one horn; round armored stone haetae enemy with fierce eyebrows. Clear functional architecture, beautiful restrained detail, avoid copying historical specific artworks.

variants.name: 황동 공방
variants.prompt: Original colorful steampunk workshop game art, polished but controlled 2D hand-painted sprites. Cobalt enamel, orange copper, ivory ceramic, dark gunmetal. Mechanical bow sentry with winding key; brass riveted mortar with blue barrel; copper coil energy pylon; ivory cooling machine with blue fins; small rust-orange one-eyed wheeled robot; stocky industrial crab automaton with armored boiler shell. Objects have convincing assembly and 4-6 major components, no excessive microdetails.

variants.name: 해협 수비대
variants.prompt: Original clean hand-painted pirate-coastal tactical game sprites. Sea navy, warm ivory, coral orange, walnut wood, turquoise accents. Naval crossbow with small bandana operator; compact ship cannon on wheeled oak carriage; bright red lighthouse beacon fire tower; frosty blue sea-glass shrine; small scarlet hermit crab pirate enemy; heavy armored blue-green shell turtle enemy. Fun original silhouettes, premium casual game finish, controlled3tone shading, not busy illustration.

variants.name: 버섯 숲 수호대
variants.prompt: Original forest creature tower-defense art in stylish 2D cel-paint with ink contours, mushroom red, jade green, golden pollen, dark bark. Compact seed-bow turret made of curved branch; stout acorn cannon; red cap mushroom alchemist on stone base casting amber spark; turquoise crystalline bulb slow tower; cute-but-mischievous purple spore creature with tiny teeth; squat armored stag beetle enemy with ivory pincers. Carefully designed characterful organic assets, no pastel, no noisy fairy scene.

variants.name: 빙하 대장간
variants.prompt: Original high-quality compact 2D winter-fortress game sprites. Iron blue, leather orange, warm ivory fur, gray stone, amber windows. Heavy crossbow on short blue stone bastion with orange banner; black barrel forge cannon; dwarf-like hooded fire smith beside compact furnace; faceted ice obelisk with silver bands; red-eyed snow imp enemy wearing brown earflaps; squat ice-armored musk ox monster. Crisp outlines and warm/cool color hierarchy; no snowfall scene, no huge auras.

variants.name: 태양 유적
variants.prompt: Original 2D stylized desert-ruins game art, terracotta/ultramarine/gold/sandstone. Compact blue-banded stone bolt launcher; copper sun-disc mortar; tiny crimson sun priest on carved pedestal; lapis ice-prism shrine; small rust scorpion enemy with expressive eyes; chunky obsidian scarab with gold shell bands. Architectural silhouettes feel crafted and playful, finely controlled3tone lighting, no elaborate filigree or full environment.

variants.name: 별시계 성채
variants.prompt: Original illustrated2D celestial clockwork tactics sprites. Deep indigo, antique gold, dusty plum, cool ivory. Crescent-shaped crossbow on a compact stone plinth; bronze clockwork cannon with visible large gear; little hooded amber star mage on a low platform; silver-blue hourglass slow tower; mischievous violet bat-like walking imp; squat armored brass owl automaton enemy. Controlled readable nighttime palette without black silhouettes, no neon, no glow clouds, elegant but game-like.

variants.name: 화산 경비대
variants.prompt: Original punchy cel-painted action strategy sprites, charcoal basalt, cobalt armor, warm iron orange, ivory markings. Short steel crossbow bastion with blue pennant; squat black mortar with copper muzzle; hooded amber ember wizard mounted on compact basalt base; vivid angular blue ice reactor; small red magma gremlin with dark rock cap; heavy plated basalt armadillo enemy with narrow orange cracks. No lava scenery, no big explosions, bold readable outlines and nice material finish.

variants.name: 픽셀 길드
variants.prompt: Original detailed-but-readable pixel art game sprites, disciplined 48x48 pixel aesthetic enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor edges, subtle 3-tone clusters not noisy dithering. Deep green, cream, cobalt, golden ochre and crimson accents. Ranger crossbow tower with tiny flag; chunky cannon with wood carriage; robed fire wizard on stone tile footing; blue ice shrine; red goblin with expressive eyes; bulky plated horned beetle. Premium indie pixel tactics sprites with clearly designed silhouettes, not crude8bit icons.
